theorems.name: Submission.dor_minimizing_limsup_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → 0 < n → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → (∀ j, IsMinimizingIn (Ts j) (U ∩ N)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ j, (Ts j).support ⊆ N) → (∀ j, BoundaryVanishes (Ts j)) → BoundaryVanishes T → (∀ j, ∀ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents (Ts j) → R.IsStationaryAlong N) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn W < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → y ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ r₁ c c₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ 0 ≤ c ∧ 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ ρ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ρ → ρ < r₁ → limsup (fun j => (Ts j).massOn (ball y ρ)) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + c * ρ) ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y (ρ + ε)) + ENNReal.ofReal (c₁ * ρ ^ (n + 1))
